Also Capital's homepage lists 'Sea12 - Forward-deployed AI engineering for legacy industry automation' linking https://www.sea12.co/; citybiz links sea12.co and The SaaS News gives 'Company Website: https://sea12.co'; both name the same co-founders (Thomas Mosen, Charles Englander) and customer (Basden Steel). An SEC full-text search shows one Form D from 'Sea12 Technologies Inc.' (Delaware, New York, NY) filed 2026-03-17. No other company called Sea12 was seen. Category set to 'adjacent' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; found through Also Capital's portfolio): Sea12 automates operational paperwork for steel, manufacturing, logistics and construction companies (order documents, routing parts to the right shop, quoting, inventory and reorder points, invoices), which touches Utopian Autonomy's RFQ / procurement-adjacent workflows at the same industrial buyers, and its manufacturing page pitches real-time operations data and safety Q&A for plant teams. It is not direct because its centre of gravity is back-office and finance work delivered as custom forward-deployed builds across several industries, not plant-floor agents for maintenance, process stability or engineering drawings, and no WhatsApp or shop-floor messaging channel was seen. Layer plant_ops is the nearest fit.

company.description: New York start-up that builds LLM automations for back-office workflows (order documents, quoting, inventory, invoicing) at manufacturing, steel, logistics and construction firms, with forward-deployed engineers.

layer_detail: Industrial back office rather than the plant floor: the Sea12 Orchestrator sits on a customer's existing applications and data feeds and automates departmental workflows (quoting and proposals, inventory levels and reorder points, invoice creation and payment processing, truck location and load updates in the TMS). At Basden Steel it handles order documents, routes parts to the right shop, processes invoices and catches double billing; construction work includes turning schedules, RFIs, submittals and cost records into a question-answering system. Manufacturing page also offers real-time operations data and a cited, safety-aware knowledge assistant. Delivered by forward-deployed engineers; users are office and operations staff.
product_summary: The Sea12 Orchestrator plus forward-deployed engineers: LLM automations built on a customer's existing applications and data feeds that run whole back-office workflows (order documents, quoting, inventory and reorder points, invoicing and payments, TMS load updates), plus natural-language knowledge search over manufacturing and safety documents.
